survivedExtractionAuthority.boundary: This proves the bounded survived-extraction condition shape only. Runtime materialization still requires proof that qualifying Equipment and extraction are coupled in the same raid.

sameRaidCouplingMaterializationPolicy.reason: The surviving authored operation promises that qualifying headset equipment is used during the bounded operation that is survived. Separate cross-raid Equipment and ExitStatus progress would violate the player-facing contract.

en.description: A headset is not a qualification. The qualification is hearing the situation early enough to make a better decision. I need field awareness, not sixteen receipts from an equipment counter.
en.started: Woods. Run one reconnaissance contact with a proven hearing-protection setup, remove two Scavs without turning the raid into a hunting ledger, and extract alive.
en.success: You heard enough to choose the contact instead of stumbling into it. That is the capability I care about; the model number on the headset is secondary.

ru.description: Гарнитура сама по себе не квалификация. Квалификация — услышать обстановку достаточно рано, чтобы принять лучшее решение. Мне нужна полевая осведомлённость, а не шестнадцать чеков со склада.
ru.started: Лес. Проведи один разведывательный контакт с подтверждённым средством защиты слуха, сними двух Диких без превращения рейда в охотничью ведомость и выйди живым.
ru.success: Ты услышал достаточно, чтобы выбрать контакт, а не ввалиться в него случайно. Вот эта способность мне нужна; модель гарнитуры вторична.

objectiveIntent: one bounded Woods reconnaissance contact while using a proven headset equipment allowlist
eliminate exactly two Scavs and survive/extract without headset-by-headset progression or gear-restricted kill ladders

boundedOperation.rationale: Woods rewards early acoustic detection and contact choice without requiring an invented hearing-event condition. Two Scavs keep the contact bounded and subordinate to the reconnaissance/survival purpose.

knownComponentOverlaps: The Survivalist Path - Tough Guy uses a single-raid Woods Scav objective with a non-equipment restriction, but survival is not required.
The Survivalist Path - Junkie uses a Woods Scav objective under a stimulant/provision effect rather than headset Equipment.
Radio Club combines Woods Scav eliminations with Survived extraction, but its defining mechanic is radio-repeater placement and it does not require a headset.
Vanilla contains equipment-restricted combat objectives, including active-headset combat outside this exact Woods/Scav/survival tuple.
vanillaOverlapDisposition.verdict: Component overlap is material but does not reproduce the complete Acoustic Contact contract. The headset is a reconnaissance capability gate, target count is deliberately bounded at two, and Survived extraction makes the objective a field-awareness operation rather than another kill ladder.
reopenConditions: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 quest data later proves a vanilla quest with the same defining tuple.
A future vanilla/SPT update introduces a materially equivalent active-headset Woods Scav-and-survive objective.

equipmentPlan.remainingBlocker: same-raid Equipment-to-contact-to-extraction coupling proof remains unresolved; vanilla semantic-overlap disposition and Economy Admiral numeric reward review are complete

operations.rewardDoctrine: XP/RUB/standing only under the approved Economy Admiral envelope. No headset storefront conveyor and no equipment unlock whose sole purpose is to start another same-shaped quest.
proofGates: exact pinned SPT 4.1.3 explicit TPL allowlist is resolved by post-010-protective-acoustic-equipment-allowlist-proof.json; parent handbook categories remain forbidden as runtime selectors
prove same-raid coupling before runtime materialization so headset Equipment, the two Savage contacts on woods and the Survived extraction cannot be satisfied across different raids
vanilla semantic-overlap review is closed as admit-bounded-differentiation; reopen only on evidence of the same defining tuple
Scorpion/Artem component-overlap review is resolved separately
